form.label: Health
form.description: Six checks that compact events arrive, their templates are stored and events expand to their original text.

single.option: 0 means the Receiver is not sending here
in the template index, all time
ready for searches to expand events

panel.title: 4. Templates received and not yet stored

search.query: index=tenx_dml sourcetype=tenx_dml_raw_json _index_latest=-10m | eval tenx_key=trim(templateHash) | stats count by tenx_key | lookup tenx-dml-lookup _key AS tenx_key OUTPUT pattern_hash AS tenx_stored | stats count as indexed, count(tenx_stored) as stored | eval missing=indexed-stored | table missing

single.option: should be 0; the store loads every 5 minutes

panel.title: 5. Templates the app refuses to expand

search.query: | inputlookup tenx-dml-lookup | where isnotnull(expand_unsafe) AND expand_unsafe!="" | stats count

single.option: should be 0; a Receiver setting causes these

search.query: `tenx-events` | head 2000 | `tenx-inflate` | stats count(eval(match(_raw, "^~"))) as n | table n

panel.title: The same event, as indexed and as a search returns it

search.query: `tenx-events` | head 200 | dedup sourcetype | head 5 | eval "As indexed (compact)"=_raw | `tenx-inflate` | rename sourcetype as Sourcetype, _raw as "As a search returns it" | table Sourcetype "As indexed (compact)" "As a search returns it"

panel.title: Compact events by index and source type

search.query: | tstats count as events max(_indextime) as last where `tenx-events` by index sourcetype | sort - events | eval Events=tostring(events, "commas"), "Last received"=strftime(last, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename index as Index, sourcetype as Sourcetype | table Index Sourcetype Events "Last received"

| inputlookup tenx-kv-state-lookup | eval "Last load"=strftime(updated, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "Loaded through"=strftime(loaded_through, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename status as Status, records as "Records in last load", detail as Detail | table "Last load" Status "Loaded through" "Records in last load" Detail

panel.title: Templates the app refuses to expand

search.query: | inputlookup tenx-dml-lookup | where isnotnull(expand_unsafe) AND expand_unsafe!="" | rename _key as Template, expand_unsafe as Reason, pattern as "Template text" | table Template Reason "Template text"

panel.title: Source types whose index-time masking does not apply to compact events

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local /servicesNS/nobody/tenx-for-splunk/configs/conf-tenx_replay count=0 | where isnotnull(masked_at_index_time) AND masked_at_index_time!="" | rename title as Sourcetype, masked_at_index_time as "Index-time rules" | table Sourcetype "Index-time rules"
